prompts.red:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent PNG overlay for a handmade portfolio video.
Input image 1: edit target, existing red stitch border. Preserve its simple drawn sewing-thread look, rectangular composition, clear open center, transparency and four complete sides.
PRIMARY CHANGE: Make every individual stitch about THREE TIMES LONGER, with a clearly exaggerated length perpendicular to the perimeter, extending both inward and outward across the seam. At a 300px-wide website thumbnail each stitch should read as a conspicuous 9–12px long thread, not a short tick. Gently thicken the strokes by 25% so they remain visible. Retain a dense hand-sewn rhythm, about 45 stitches per horizontal side and 23 per vertical side, with mild handmade variation.
COLOR CHANGE: uniform bright coral vermilion red, target #EF5948. Much brighter and livelier than the existing dark muted color. Opaque colorful thread with just slight pencil/fiber texture; no dark outline, no muddy shadows.
Stitch construction: long diagonal overcast stitches / / / crossing the continuous thread seam. Rounded ends, tiny hand tremor. Simple crossed corner joins.
GEOMETRY: 1600 by 900 transparent canvas. The continuous rectangular perimeter thread is centered 50px in from each canvas edge (rectangle x=50..1550, y=50..850). Each long stitch spans roughly 75–85px across this line, half inside and half outside. All tips fully visible, with at least 5px transparent margin outside the outermost tips. Geometry is shared across the three color variants.
Background and entire interior must be genuinely alpha transparent, not cream or white, no checkerboard. Only the thread pixels are visible. Do not include fabric, patches, shadows, text, video content, objects, labels, watermarks, or a second rectangle. Output just ONE complete red frame.
